root_cause.text: The `mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211` function lacks a length validation check on the socket buffer (`skb->len`) before accessing the management action frame fields in the `mgmt` structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds the check `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1` in `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c` immediately before evaluating `mgmt->u.action.category` and `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code`.
